meta.descricao: Get in touch with Valejas Atlético Clube — email, phone, address and location. We're in Valejas, Oeiras.

hero.texto: Questions, partnerships, press or signing up — talk to us by email or phone, or drop by the clubhouse.

email.geral: For everything. If in doubt, use this one

formulario.obrigado: We'll reply soon. Thanks for getting in touch.
formulario.assuntoNota: The subject decides who gets it: sports go to the coordinators, partnerships to the communications team, everything else to the general inbox.

restaurante.texto: Home-style Portuguese food at the club, with a dish of the day at lunchtime and generous portions. To book a table, call the restaurant directly.

pratos.cozido: <dia>Thursdays:</dia> cozido à portuguesa (Portuguese boiled meats and vegetables)

restaurante.servicos: Eat in or take away. Reservations accepted.
restaurante.atalho: Book a table at the club's restaurant
